kill_switch.comment: OFF by default. Benchmarks are no-ops until explicitly enabled.

iteration_params.comment: Uses real TCP sockets on 127.0.0.1 (ephemeral ports). Two in-process nodes exchange framed messages.

benchmark_suites.name: Heartbeat roundtrip
benchmark_suites.measures: End-to-end TCP roundtrip: encode -> send -> recv -> FramedReader -> decode

benchmark_suites.name: Incident report roundtrip
benchmark_suites.measures: Medium-sized message with source IP, port, severity, score, label

benchmark_suites.name: Threat intel share roundtrip
benchmark_suites.measures: Larger message with threat intel entry (kind, IP, hash, domain, confidence)

benchmark_suites.name: Multi-message stream
benchmark_suites.measures: Batch throughput: 10 messages per roundtrip, tests FramedReader reassembly

benchmark_suites.name: Failover/reconnect cycle
benchmark_suites.measures: Connection setup + teardown cycle time (bind + listen + accept + connect + close)

baseline_results.comment: All 5 thresholds PASS. Federation sustains 200k+ msgs/sec on loopback.

production_capacity_guide.comment: 100 nodes x 0.2 heartbeats/sec = 20 msgs/sec. Benchmarked at 286k msgs/sec = 14,000x headroom. Federation has ample capacity for large clusters.
